title: Italian, B.S. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: University Park. Unlike German/French B.S. (three named options each), Italian's B.S. has no named options at all -- one straightforward track built around 'skills in Italian... for careers in professional areas where fluency in Italian is particularly relevant,' the same shape as Philosophy B.S. Sibling of the already-built Italian B.A. (ITBA-2026.json), reusing it_catalog.json's IT 1->2->3 coded chain. Added 2 missing courses with real prereqs confirmed via direct DOM inspection: IT 412 (prescribed; needs any 300-level IT course, modeled as IT 301 or IT 320) and IT 99 (a real variable-credit, 1-12cr max-12, no-prereq study-abroad course -- modeled as a single 6cr pick satisfying the bulletin's own 'minimum 6 credits in a Penn State education abroad program in Italy' requirement literally, rather than a generic slot, since it's a real enumerated course). The 15cr 'select from' Additional-course pool is satisfied entirely by 5 already-cataloged, prereq-free courses (IT 130/131/225N/240Q/490) -- no new catalog entries needed there. The 21cr 'related areas' Supporting requirement (6+ at 400-level, adviser-driven) is modeled as generic slots, same convention as French/German B.S.'s Applied Options. RE-VERIFIED against the live bulletin (2026-08): confirmed the major's real 51cr total splits as Prescribed 6cr (IT 301+412) + Additional 18cr (IT 310-or-320, 15cr from an enumerated list -- this plan's IT 320+130+131+225N+240Q+490 already correctly totals exactly 18cr) + Supporting 27cr (6cr study abroad + 21cr related areas, min 6 at 400-level). Recounting this plan's own generic 'Related area'/'Related area 400-level' slots plus IT 99 found only 24cr of Supporting modeled (a real, confirmed 3cr shortfall against the live page's 27cr) -- fixed by converting Semester 8's extra generic Elective into a 5th 'Related area course' slot (credit-neutral; total plan credits unchanged at 125cr).
